vulnerabilities.name: In-Band Internal Secret Disclosure
vulnerabilities.description: The application accepts a user-controlled URL and fetches a restricted internal resource, returning confidential content directly in the HTTP response.
vulnerabilities.what_happened: The application accepts a user-controlled URL and fetches a restricted internal resource, returning confidential content directly in the HTTP response.
vulnerabilities.impact: An attacker can directly read sensitive internal files, API tokens, and private services that are not exposed to the public internet.
vulnerabilities.why_it_matters: An attacker can directly read sensitive internal files, API tokens, and private services that are not exposed to the public internet.
evidence: Disclosed internal header: X-Internal-Service=SSRF-Sentinel-Mock
Confirmed internal verification marker: SSRF_SENTINEL_INTERNAL_ACCESS_2026
Probe 'Internal Secret Access' (PL-INBAND-001) accessed internal resource via parameter 'url'.
Disclosed internal header: X-Internal-Service=SSRF-Sentinel-Core
Disclosed internal header: X-Resource-ID=admin-config-vault
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Enforce a strict domain and IP allowlist on outgoing requests. Block loopback (127.0.0.0/8) and private IP ranges at the application and firewall level.
vulnerabilities.recommended_fix: Enforce a strict domain and IP allowlist on outgoing requests. Block loopback (127.0.0.0/8) and private IP ranges at the application and firewall level.

vulnerabilities.name: Alternative Host Representation Filter Bypass
vulnerabilities.description: The URL validation parser fails to normalize alternative host notations (e.g., decimal DWORD, octal, hex, shorthand, IPv6), allowing attackers to bypass standard loopback string filters.
vulnerabilities.what_happened: The URL validation parser fails to normalize alternative host notations (e.g., decimal DWORD, octal, hex, shorthand, IPv6), allowing attackers to bypass standard loopback string filters.
vulnerabilities.impact: Bypasses naive blacklist filters that only match '127.0.0.1' or 'localhost', granting access to internal resources.
vulnerabilities.why_it_matters: Bypasses naive blacklist filters that only match '127.0.0.1' or 'localhost', granting access to internal resources.
evidence: Disclosed internal header: X-Internal-Service=SSRF-Sentinel-Mock
Confirmed internal verification marker: SSRF_SENTINEL_INTERNAL_ACCESS_2026
Probe 'Decimal DWORD IP Representation' (PL-BYPASS-DEC-001) accessed internal resource via parameter 'url'.
Probe 'Shorthand IP Representation' (PL-BYPASS-SHORT-002) accessed internal resource via parameter 'url'.
Probe 'Octal IP Representation' (PL-BYPASS-OCT-003) accessed internal resource via parameter 'url'.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Resolve the hostname or IP to its canonical socket address prior to validation, and evaluate the resolved IP address against an allowlist.
vulnerabilities.recommended_fix: Resolve the hostname or IP to its canonical socket address prior to validation, and evaluate the resolved IP address against an allowlist.

vulnerabilities.name: Redirect-Based SSRF Chaining
vulnerabilities.description: The application's HTTP client automatically follows HTTP 301/302 redirects without re-validating the destination target, allowing an attacker to pivot into internal services.
vulnerabilities.what_happened: The application's HTTP client automatically follows HTTP 301/302 redirects without re-validating the destination target, allowing an attacker to pivot into internal services.
vulnerabilities.impact: Bypasses initial URL validation checks by bouncing through external or open redirect endpoints to reach protected internal hosts.
vulnerabilities.why_it_matters: Bypasses initial URL validation checks by bouncing through external or open redirect endpoints to reach protected internal hosts.
evidence: Disclosed internal header: X-Internal-Service=SSRF-Sentinel-Mock
Confirmed internal verification marker: SSRF_SENTINEL_INTERNAL_ACCESS_2026
Probe 'Internal HTTP 302 Redirect to Secret' (PL-REDIR-INT-001) accessed internal resource via parameter 'url'.
Probe 'Public Application Open Redirect Bounce' (PL-REDIR-PUB-002) accessed internal resource via parameter 'url'.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Disable automatic redirect following or strictly re-validate every redirect Location header against the authorized allowlist before following.
vulnerabilities.recommended_fix: Disable automatic redirect following or strictly re-validate every redirect Location header against the authorized allowlist before following.

vulnerabilities.name: Limited-Response SSRF
vulnerabilities.description: The application executes server-side requests to internal endpoints and reveals internal state through status codes (HTTP 204), custom headers, or response lengths.
vulnerabilities.what_happened: The application executes server-side requests to internal endpoints and reveals internal state through status codes (HTTP 204), custom headers, or response lengths.
vulnerabilities.impact: Enables internal port scanning, service discovery, and mapping of active internal infrastructure.
vulnerabilities.why_it_matters: Enables internal port scanning, service discovery, and mapping of active internal infrastructure.
evidence: Target returned HTTP 204 No Content confirming internal request execution.
Internal header marker 'SSRF_HEADER_ONLY_FLAG' discovered in response headers.
Disclosed partial/truncated internal secret fragment in response stream.
Application returned generic internal success confirmation distinct from error baseline.
Internal policy filter suppression marker '[CONTENT_SUPPRESSED_BY_POLICY]' verified.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Do not forward downstream HTTP status codes or custom headers to the user. Always return uniform application responses.
vulnerabilities.recommended_fix: Do not forward downstream HTTP status codes or custom headers to the user. Always return uniform application responses.

vulnerabilities.name: Blind SSRF via Local Callback
vulnerabilities.description: The application triggers an outbound HTTP request to a dedicated local callback listener without reflecting the response content to the user.
vulnerabilities.what_happened: The application triggers an outbound HTTP request to a dedicated local callback listener without reflecting the response content to the user.
vulnerabilities.impact: Enables attackers to trigger unauthenticated internal API requests, interact with internal services, or interact with webhook endpoints.
vulnerabilities.why_it_matters: Enables attackers to trigger unauthenticated internal API requests, interact with internal services, or interact with webhook endpoints.
evidence: Out-of-Band callback confirmed! Received 1 request(s) with token 'ssrf_tok_64f4fe14597da5c2' from IP 127.0.0.1 at 2026-11-28T07:32:01.235Z (Poll time: 0.001s).
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Enforce network egress filtering restricting the application from initiating connections to unauthorized ports and destinations.
vulnerabilities.recommended_fix: Enforce network egress filtering restricting the application from initiating connections to unauthorized ports and destinations.

vulnerabilities.name: Time-Based SSRF
vulnerabilities.description: The application induces measurable, repeatable response delays when fetching slow or delayed internal resources.
vulnerabilities.what_happened: The application induces measurable, repeatable response delays when fetching slow or delayed internal resources.
vulnerabilities.impact: Enables attackers to infer whether internal network ports or endpoints are open based on round-trip latency differentials.
vulnerabilities.why_it_matters: Enables attackers to infer whether internal network ports or endpoints are open based on round-trip latency differentials.
evidence: Confirmed internal delayed execution marker 'SSRF_TIME_DELAYED_SUCCESS' in delayed response.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Configure strict connection and read timeouts (e.g. 2.0 seconds or less) on all server-side HTTP clients.
vulnerabilities.recommended_fix: Configure strict connection and read timeouts (e.g. 2.0 seconds or less) on all server-side HTTP clients.

vulnerabilities.name: Boolean-Based SSRF
vulnerabilities.description: The application returns distinctly different HTTP statuses, lengths, or headers when evaluating downstream conditional queries.
vulnerabilities.what_happened: The application returns distinctly different HTTP statuses, lengths, or headers when evaluating downstream conditional queries.
vulnerabilities.impact: Allows attackers to infer internal data or configuration states through systematic true/false condition testing.
vulnerabilities.why_it_matters: Allows attackers to infer internal data or configuration states through systematic true/false condition testing.
evidence: TRUE: HTTP 200 (303 bytes) | FALSE: HTTP 404 (88 bytes) | Length Delta: 215 bytes
Boolean verification marker 'SSRF_BOOLEAN_TRUE_VERIFIED' matched with divergent status (200 vs 404).
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Ensure the application returns uniform HTTP status codes, body lengths, and error responses regardless of downstream condition evaluations.
vulnerabilities.recommended_fix: Ensure the application returns uniform HTTP status codes, body lengths, and error responses regardless of downstream condition evaluations.
